examples.en: The rainforests are disappearing at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 雨林正以惊人的速度消失。

examples.en: It is vital that we act to stop the destruction of the rainforests.
examples.zh: 至关紧要的是，我们应当采取行动制止破坏雨林。

examples.en: Tropical rainforests have the most varied assemblage of plants in the world.
examples.zh: 热带雨林集聚了世界上种类最繁多的植物。
